name: King of Maacah
overview: The King of Maacah was a male ruler noted for his military support of the Ammonites, bringing 1,000 men to their side during a conflict. Scripture identifies him by his title rather than a personal name, and no additional tribal or familial details are provided.
namesAndTitles: The title 'King of Maacah' literally means 'king of Maacah,' indicating his rule over the region of Maacah. This designation is a straightforward title without a personal name or divine attribution, as recorded in 2 Samuel 10:6.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for the King of Maacah beyond what is indicated by his role as a military ally; no personal or familial connections are documented.
scriptureSignificance: This king's significance lies in his contribution of military forces to the Ammonite side, demonstrating the alliances and regional powers involved in the conflicts described in 2 Samuel. His involvement highlights the broader political and military dynamics surrounding Israel's neighbors during this period.
